sloka: कच्चिन्मन्त्रयसे नैक: कच्चिन्न बहुभि: सह ।कच्चित्ते मन्त्रितो मन्त्रो राष्ट्रं न परिधावति ॥ २.१००.१९॥
transliteration: kaccinmantrayase naika: kaccinna bahubhi: saha ।kaccitte mantrito mantro rāṣṭraṁ na paridhāvati ॥ 2.100.19॥

translations.english: O Bharata, having determined on an endeavour involving a little effort and yielding great results, I trust you commence to execute it quickly without procrastination?
